name: Nakagawa (Tochigi, Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Nakagawa town emblem in green and red: a green stylised letter N of two curved strokes in two shades, with a red disc.
history: Municipal flag of Nakagawa, a town in Tochigi Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 October 2005.

features.role: Nakagawa town emblem — a green stylised letter N of two curved strokes in two shades, with a red disc
